svg.text: SLAM 450 v0.91 squad races, plan view (seed 45046, PowerSLAM v0.40 harbour)
Recorded tracks in local metres, x=east, y=north, one common scale. RED: A1 SLAM quad + H1 Haiku 5.5. BLUE: A2 SLAM quad + A3 SLAM wing + H2 Haiku 5.5. Dashed = Haiku.

Squares = targets (shade = number, z = height; moving: hollow = start, dotted = path, solid = claim/end). Ring = claimed (ring colour = claimant, @tick). Dot = track end. X = knocked out. North is up.
PowerSLAM model footprints only; not surveyed coastline. Generated natively by bin/render450_squad_topdown.rex from the race evidence.
